title: Trenching & Excavation Risk Assessment
description: Free Trenching & Excavation Risk Assessment template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers excavation information, soil classification and testing - osha appendix a, protective system design - osha requi
topics: Soil Classification And Testing - OSHA Appendix A

Soil Classification And Testing - OSHA Appendix A

VISUAL TEST:

☐ Grain size (coarse vs fine) ☐ Plasticity (moist soil rolled into thread)

☐ Thumb penetration test:

- Type A: Can be indented by thumb with great difficulty

- Type B: Can be indented by thumb with moderate effort

- Type C: Can be easily indented by thumb

EXCAVATION METHOD WITHIN UTILITY ZONE:

Within 0.9m (3ft) of marked utilities:

☐ Hand digging only ☐ Vacuum excavation ☐ Air knife ☐ Water jet

UTILITY PROTECTION MEASURES:

☐ Utility supported/suspended where exposed

☐ Backfill with sand/select material

☐ Warning tape/barrier above utility

☐ Photographs taken before backfill

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES FOR UTILITY STRIKE:

Gas strike: Evacuate immediately, call 911, notify utility

Electric strike: Stay in equipment, call utility, no approach

Water main: Evacuate, notify utility, implement dewatering

RESCUE PROCEDURE:

1. Call 911 immediately - specify trench collapse

2. Establish command post - Site Supervisor: ______________

3. Assess scene safety - competent person to evaluate further collapse risk

4. Control hazards - stop equipment, shut off utilities

5. Initiate rescue - use trained personnel only

6. Provide medical care as soon as victim reached

7. Preserve scene for investigation
